QUOTE: So a zero from `search` licenses "no indexed code symbol by this name." It does not license "the repository does not contain it."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer distinguishes "absent from the indexed corpus" from "absent from the repository", which is the nothing-exists versus did-not-look-there distinction. It also notes that token_hits identifies the token that emptied the search. It does not say a previous version treated a single non-matching token as proof of absence, but it does say a bare "not found" must not be read as a definitive negative.
